text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I just need to randomly ask the 
Tomakomai City trivia written on this 
page, right!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I want to train so I can answer 
right away whenever asked. I think I've 
memorized that page, but... just to be 
safe, please quiz me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Okay, let's keep it moving! Question 1! 
'Name three class-B rivers that flow 
through Tomakomai City.'"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Abira River, Bibi River, Yufutsu River!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Awesome! Question 2! "In what year was 
Lake Utonai designated as a Special 
Protection Area of a National Wildlife 
Protection Area?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ding-dong! Correct! Question three! 
"...What is Tomakomai's famous feng shui 
power spot?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Um, Mount Tarumae Shrine, I'd say. 
Mount Tarumae in particular is a wonderful 
place that's been worshipped as a sacred 
mountain since long ago!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wait, was that even a problem in the first 
place?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry, sorry! I just figured you 
might easily spill the beans right now!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, Tarumaesan Shrine, huh... Looks 
like my destination for the next long 
weekend is decided♪
